Klasse Server

java.lang.Object
org.golfit.server.Server
Alle implementierten Schnittstellen:
ServerContext
public class Server extends Object implements ServerContext
The GolfIt game server. Listens for UDP packets on a given port, creates a ClientHandler per unique client address, and dispatches incoming messages to the appropriate handlers (system, movement, chat).

  • Methodendetails

    • start

      public void start()
      Starts the server main loop.

      This method:

      1. Opens a DatagramSocket on port
      2. Schedules a cleanup task every 10 seconds to remove timed-out clients
      3. Enters an infinite receive loop — each incoming packet is routed to its ClientHandler, creating one if this is a new client address

      A client is identified by its "ip:port" string. If a packet arrives from an unknown address, a new ClientHandler is created and submitted to the thread pool.

    • generateUniqueId

      public int generateUniqueId()
      Generates a unique integer client ID based on timing, memory, and random data.

      The result is always positive and never 0 (ID_INVALID) or 1 (ID_SERVER).

      Angegeben von:
      generateUniqueId in Schnittstelle ServerContext
      Gibt zurück:
      a unique positive integer client ID

    • dispatch

      private void dispatch(String clientKey, MessageParser.Message message) throws Exception
      Dispatches a parsed message from a client to the appropriate handler.

      Routing is based on message type:

      • SYS_CONNECT — handled by SystemHandler.onConnect(ClientHandler, MessageParser.Message), assigns username and ID
      • SYS_PING — handled by SystemHandler.onPing(ClientHandler, MessageParser.Message), updates last ping time and sends pong
      Parameter:
      clientKey - the "ip:port" key identifying the sender
      message - the parsed incoming message
      Löst aus:
      Exception - if a handler throws during processing
